title: From one cell to a whole pack
narration: A single cell supplies only about 3.6 volts. That can run a phone, but a car needs hundreds of volts. So cells are wired together. Linked side by side, they add capacity, meaning how much charge they hold. Linked end to end, they add up their voltage. Take the 2022 Chevrolet Bolt. Its 288 cells are joined three at a time, side by side, into 96 groups. Those groups are chained end to end across 10 modules, giving the pack about 350 volts.
